comparisons.quantity: energy through the sphere r = lambda in one period
comparisons.how: real fields, 48 instants x 32 Gauss points: a 3D+t integral

checks.name: Gauss's law div D = rho (x, y, z, t grid 21^3 x 64)
checks.detail: div D - rho: ||sum of terms|| / sum of ||term|| = 0.00113; r(2h)/r(h) = 3.84: discretisation error (the field obeys the law); extrapolated residual 6.22e-05

checks.name: Gauss's law for B, div B = 0 (x, y, z, t grid 21^3 x 64)
checks.detail: div B: ||sum of terms|| / sum of ||term|| = 0.00133; r(2h)/r(h) = 3.97: discretisation error (the field obeys the law); extrapolated residual 1.24e-05

checks.name: Faraday's law curl E = -dB/dt (x, y, z, t grid 21^3 x 64)
checks.detail: curl E + dB/dt: ||sum of terms|| / sum of ||term|| = 0.000935; r(2h)/r(h) = 4.96: discretisation error (the field obeys the law); extrapolated residual 0

checks.name: Ampere-Maxwell law curl H = J + dD/dt (x, y, z, t grid 21^3 x 64)
checks.detail: curl H - J - dD/dt: ||sum of terms|| / sum of ||term|| = 0.000878; r(2h)/r(h) = 5.31: discretisation error (the field obeys the law); extrapolated residual 0

checks.name: Poynting energy balance (x, y, z, t grid 21^3 x 64)
checks.detail: U(t1) - U(t0) = -2.531e-14, outflow 2.53e-14, dissipated 0 (J per unit length along absent axes)
